parameters.description: Parameters for the conditional simulation compute task.

source_object.description: Reference to the Geoscience Object containing the source data used for conditioning the simulation. Supported object types are point sets, downhole intervals, 3D grids (regular, masked, or tensor) and block models. For grids and block models, the cell or block centroids are used as the conditioning locations.

source_attribute.description: Reference to the attribute containing the source values. The values are transformed to normal-score space using the provided distribution.
